query:
SELECT 
  s.id,
  s.firstName,
  s.lastName,
  s.email,
  s.photoUrl,
  s.beltRank,
  s.program,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN sa.status = 'missed' THEN 1 END) as absences,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN sa.status = 'attended' THEN 1 END) as attended,
  ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN sa.status = 'attended' THEN 1 END) / 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN sa.status = 'attended' THEN 1 END) + COUNT(CASE WHEN sa.status = 'missed' THEN 1 END)), 1) as attendance_rate
FROM students s
LEFT JOIN student_attendance sa ON s.id = sa.studentId
WHERE sa.status IN ('attended', 'missed')
GROUP BY s.id, s.firstName, s.lastName, s.email, s.photoUrl, s.beltRank, s.program
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN sa.status = 'missed' THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY absences DESC
LIMIT 10;
